summary: Accesses the fitted face mesh generated by Face Track CHOP, either as GPU-direct render geometry or editable SOP geometry.

key_params.name: directtogpu
key_params.note: Upload mesh directly to GPU instead of editable SOP output.

key_params.name: pretransform
key_params.note: Apply pre-transform alignment to source-image UV space.

common_gotchas: Face Track SOP is Windows-only and depends on the NVIDIA Maxine AR SDK.
A compatible `.nvf` face mesh file is required and does not ship with TouchDesigner.
GPU-direct output is render-oriented; disable it when downstream editable SOP geometry is needed.
key_concepts: Face Track SOP consumes the fitted face mesh produced by Face Track CHOP.
`directtogpu` can upload geometry directly for rendering or output editable SOP geometry for downstream SOP work.
`pretransform` aligns the mesh to source image UV space by default; disabling it expects CHOP transform channels to align the mesh.
`normals` generates normals for the face mesh output.
